run_seg_mustc_data_cli: run the seg_mustc_data CLI to segment MuST-C audio into individual wav files per utterance
run_main_function: run the main function to extract waveform and text from a MuST-C dataset split
create_wav_files_per_utterance: create individual wav files for each utterance in the MuST-C dataset using soundfile
generate_text_and_wav_list: generate text annotation files and wav file path lists from MuST-C dataset splits
review_mustc_dataset_iteration: review the MUSTC dataset iteration pattern that yields waveform, sample rate, text, and utterance ID
